sourceProjection.basis: Visually reviewed Comune di Venezia reconstruction volume page 144 (PDF page 183): the four labelled plans AB, CD, Pianta cella and EF are top-down orthographic sections on the same scale-marked project plate; the elevation and longitudinal section are excluded.

Visually reviewed Cicognara 1858 plate 15. Its ground and bell-cell plans remain an archival comparison only; no generated floor selects this source because it predates the 1902 collapse and 1912 reconstruction.

review: The post-reconstruction volume was issued for the Comune di Venezia in 1912. Page 144 (PDF 183) was inspected at high resolution: all four horizontal plans are complete within their crops and the page caption identifies them as the general Commission project. Page 173 (PDF 212) documents thirty-six reconstructed ramps and an electric lift, but the plan plate does not label the lift shaft or the current ticket entrance.
limitations: 四层平面均来自威尼斯市政府 1912 年重建专书同一张带比例尺的委员会工程图；记录重建结构，不等同于竣工实测或当前运营导览图。
正文证实重建时设有电梯，但平面未标明电梯井与现行售票入口，故不添加推测点位或电梯连线。
钟室平面未单独标注朝向，南、西、北三处观景停靠仅绑定钟室整体，不虚构栏边方位点。
